page_note: 这是AFP数据可视化指南第5页，两栏正文讨论预测可信度与Metapraxis的“Windsock”图，页面下半是一张无编号的“Western Europe Net Sales Windsock”组合图（灰色情景带＋预算/去年/预测三条线）。

components.evidence: grey filled `Scenarios` bands and three plotted lines (`Budget`, `Prior Year`, `Forecast`) share one panel
grey `Scenarios` bands fan from ~118-212 in Jan, text calls it "a statistical risk range"
flat orange `Budget` rule at ~218 and red `Prior Year` rule at ~166 run the full width, each with a legend entry
legend row `Scenarios | Budget | Prior Year | Forecast` sits between the title and the plot
lowest y tick printed is `100`, no break glyph on the axis
`$m` set above the top tick `220`, not alongside the axis
only scale word on the figure is `$m` at the axis head; ticks are bare 100...220
faint dotted horizontal rules at 120,140,...,220; no vertical grid across the panel
first x tick reads `Jan` with a bare `14` stacked beneath it
legend shows three grey shades separated by commas for one label `Scenarios`, shade = range level
two-column body text runs above/around the chart, ending "(see below)" and describing the chart

new_components.name: multi_swatch_single_legend_entry
new_components.evidence: legend reads three grey squares joined by commas then one label `Scenarios`
new_components.why_it_matters: 一个图例条目对应三层不同灰度的带，读值时无法从图例区分内、中、外带各自的数值范围。

new_components.name: nested_range_bands
new_components.evidence: three concentric grey bands fan out from a single Jan point, widening toward May
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一月份存在三对上下边界值，取值必须先指明是哪一层情景带的上界或下界。

new_components.name: series_ends_before_axis_end
new_components.evidence: `Forecast` line and grey bands stop at May, dashed vertical rule at May; axis continues to Dec
new_components.why_it_matters: Jun–Dec 各月对 Forecast 与 Scenarios 无数据点，表格中这些格位应为空而非0。

new_components.name: constant_series_across_all_categories
new_components.evidence: `Budget` ~218 and `Prior Year` ~166 are perfectly flat across Jan 14 to Dec
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一数值在12个月份重复出现，行标签只靠月份无法唯一定位某个读数。

spot_checks.mark: the flat orange Budget line, read at Jan 14
the same flat Budget line read at a later month (it is constant, e.g. Dec)
the flat red Prior Year line, read at Jan 14
the flat red Prior Year line, read at a mid-year month (e.g. Jun)
the flat red Prior Year line, read at a late month (e.g. Dec)
the Forecast line at its Jan 14 start, sitting on the Budget level
the Forecast line endpoint at May, on the dashed vertical rule

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数字标注，也没有 Source/Note 行或数据表，解析器输出里根本不会出现 218、216、200 这些串——图形整体被跳过。相比之下读值本身不算最难：网格线每20 $m一条，5%容差在218处约±10.9 $m，等于半格，肉眼把 Forecast 的Feb读成216或218都在容差内。标签层也有麻烦但可解：Budget≈218与Prior Year≈166在Jan 14至Dec十二个月份完全水平，同一数值重复12次，行键必须靠系列名而非月份区分；而Jun–Dec对Forecast与Scenarios无数据，表格需留空。
